headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 9-4 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, behind a strong performance from their offense. Sal Stewart led the charge with a 4-hit, 1-home run game, including a key homer that scored JJ Bleday. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-3, with Jesse Scholtens earning the win and Ian Seymour notching the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Brenton Doyle, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to a left oblique contusion. The Atlanta Braves have transferred Hurston Waldrep to the 60-day injured list after right elbow surgery. The Houston Astros have placed Lance McCullers Jr. on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 16, 2026, due to right shoulder inflammation.

The Cincinnati Reds made a notable trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins in exchange for RF Rece Hinds. The Tampa Bay Rays also made a trade, sending LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Twins in 4-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 4-1 victory over the Houston Astros, with Joe Ryan earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Ryan Kreidler led the Astros' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Rockies in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 5-4 victory over the Colorado Rockies, with Jacob Latz earning the win after 2.0 innings of scoreless relief. Ezequiel Duran led the Rangers' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their latest matchup. Impact players for the Guardians included Patrick Bailey, Brayan Rocchio, and Dillon Dingler, while Joey Cantillo stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Brandon Lowe and Marcell Ozuna leading the way for the winning team. Impact performances also came from Henry Davis and Alec Burleson.

top_news.title: **Rockies CF Brenton Doyle Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies center fielder Brenton Doyle has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique contusion, effective retroactive to May 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins.
